name: Passive buzzer (piezo, plays tones)
description: Piezo sounder with no oscillator of its own: it plays the frequency you drive it with, so tone(pin, 440) plays A4 and melodies work. + to a GPIO (any pin for tone()), − to GND. A plain digitalWrite(HIGH) only clicks. The simulator reports the frequency, the note name and the melody played, so tests can check a tune.

props.label: Resonant frequency
props.description: Where it is loudest. 12 mm piezo sounders: about 4 kHz; it gets quieter away from it.

footprint: THT 12 mm round piezo sounder, 7.6 mm lead pitch (no sticker, open bottom)

bindings.description: Frequency playing now in Hz (0 when silent), measured from the pin's period.
Nearest note name, e.g. "A4" (empty when silent).
Frequency of the last tone played (stays after it stops).
Number of tones started since reset (a new tone = sound starts or the pitch changes by > 1 %).
The last 24 notes played, space separated, e.g. "C4 E4 G4 C5".
Relative loudness 0..1 (drive level and distance from the resonant frequency).
